name: Fukusa Chado
description: Fukusa Chado — a tea ceremony school theme laid out as a mosaic of soft rounded cards, with a formal top header: the school name and tagline on the left, the menu in the bar and the Book a trial lesson button on the right (an overlay menu on phones and tablets). Tokiwa evergreen (#007B43) is the main colour: the cover hero, the tea room band, every page head and the overlay menu are full green fields with a faint tatami weave, set in cream. The hero is centred giant type — the lesson days, the title in very large display type, the lead and the buttons on one axis — with a cut-out clay tea bowl that breaks out over the hero bottom edge and a cut-out whisk leaning out of the right edge. The four classes and a pull quote sit in a card mosaic of different sizes and colours; the tea room band sets four and a half in giant type beside rounded picture cards, with the cut-out whisk breaking over its top edge. Every picture is a soft matte 3D clay illustration. Kaisei Opti for display, Mulish for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-3 (card-mosaic, centered-giant-type hero, top-bar nav, full-illustration, 3d-clay, tokiwa #007B43, Kaisei Opti + Mulish, education-classes). A formal top header: school name and tagline on the left, the menu in the bar and the Book a trial lesson button on the right; an overlay menu below 1180 px. Card mosaic: the four classes, a pull quote and a seasons picture as rounded cards of different sizes and colours on a rectangular grid, rounded picture cards and step cards throughout. Centred giant type: lesson days, eyebrow, the title in very large display type, lead and buttons on one centred axis on the green field. Full illustration: every picture is a soft matte 3D clay illustration. Break-frame: the cut-out clay tea bowl (transparent WebP) sits under the hero buttons and breaks out over the green hero bottom edge into the term board below, and the cut-out whisk leans out over the hero right edge; the cut-out whisk also breaks over the top edge of the green tea room band and over the bottom edge of every page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Serif TC Bold subset (mincho, matching Kaisei Opti).

summary.zh-TW: 常磐綠的茶道教室：置中巨字主視覺、圓角卡片拼貼課程，3D 黏土插畫茶碗破框而出，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A tokiwa-green tea ceremony school: giant centred type, a mosaic of rounded class cards and a clay tea bowl breaking out.
summary.ja: 常磐色の茶道教室。中央の大きな文字、角の丸いカードを組んだお稽古紹介、枠を飛び出す粘土の茶碗。五か国語つき。
summary.fr: Une école de thé vert tokiwa : grand titre centré, mosaïque de cartes arrondies et bol en argile qui déborde du cadre.
summary.de: Eine Teeschule in Tokiwa-Grün: riesige zentrierte Schrift, Mosaik runder Kurskarten und eine Tonschale, die ausbricht.
